# laravelcloud_websocket_applications (Resource)

Manages an application on a Laravel Cloud websocket server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelcloud_websocket_applications" "example" {
  name             = "example-name"
  websocket_server = "websocket_server-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `websocket_server` (String) The websocketServer this resource belongs to.

### Optional

- `activity_timeout` (Number)
- `allowed_origins` (List of String)
- `ping_interval` (Number)
- `websocket_application` (String) The websocket application identifier

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelcloud_websocket_applications.example websocket_server-id/the-id
```
